title: Claude coded Cube Wars in a weekend. You can flood your opponent’s mine.
author: dos884
selftext:
Claude wrote my turn-based Minecraft war game over a weekend. Now I need opponents.

It’s called Cube Wars. Command an army, build bridges, dig through the map—or breach a reservoir and flood your opponent’s mine.

I designed the rules and playtested; Claude wrote all the code. My goal is a playground where a few simple rules create clever, unexpected tactics.

It’s free, open source, and playable in your browser. Still rough, especially the explanations. Come try something devious and tell me what breaks.

Play: https://cubewars.io/

Source: https://github.com/dos884/block\_wars
